paper_title: PyramidInfer Pyramid KV Cache Compression for High-throughput LLM   Inference
caption: The perplexity standard deviations when only PvCs are reserved at each layer.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the perplexity standard deviation at each layer of a model, measured in units of standard deviation. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” runs from 0 to approximately 30, with a linear scale and regular intervals of approximately 3.5 units. The y-axis, labeled “(log) Std,” extends from approximately 0 to 1.75 and utilizes a logarithmic scale with tick marks at 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5, and 1.75. A single orange line, displayed as a solid line with marker points, begins at a value near 1.7 in the first layer and decreases towards a value of approximately 0.08 at the final layer, with a lowest recorded value of 0.03.
